title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Donuts Strawberry & Cream 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Doozy Vape Co.’s Seriously Donuts Strawberry and Cream e-liquid is a classic dessert pairing translated into a smooth, balanced bakery vape profile. This blend combines the fresh, jammy berry notes of sweet Strawberry with a thick, velvety layer of rich Cream. Balanced on above a soft Donut base, these contrasting elements create a highly satisfying and multi-dimensional vape that remains consistently rich from the first inhale to the final exhale. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mod vape kits and sub-ohm tanks .
